subject: [PATCH bpf-next 0/3] bpf, cgroup: Don't wait for cgroup_mutex to read or free cgroup bpf state

reviews.author: Tejun Heo
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch series, indicating no major issues or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 09:27:12AM -0800, Shakeel Butt wrote:
> In the Meta fleet, BPF_PROG_QUERY callers, link-info readers and the
> cgroup bpf release work often wait minutes for cgroup_mutex. The holder is
> almost always a cgroup mkdir or rmdir stuck on kernfs_rwsem. In one day,
> hung-task reports showed this on 1,075 hosts (query), 94 hosts (link info)
> and 458 hosts (release work).

For the series,

Acked-by: Tejun Heo <tj@kernel.org>

Thanks.

--
tejun

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch series addresses performance issues in the BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) subsystem by introducing a new mutex to protect cgroup bpf state, thus reducing contention on cgroup_mutex. The patches also fix two old races related to attach and query operations.
